basics.name: Will Dunlop MSc ACA
basics.summary: Solutions oriented industry specialist leveraging experience as an ICAEW Chartered Accountant to build informed business solutions and expert systems, ranging from data analytics to automations and agentic AI.

work.name: Grant Thornton UK LLP
work.position: Digital Audit Manager | Automation, Analytics & AI Lead
work.summary: Led the development of innovative solutions to digitally transform the audit practice and enabled data-driven decisions.
highlights: Architected, designed, and developed 15+ digital audit tools, spanning automation, data analytics, agentic AI and expert systems; enhancing audit efficiency and insight generation for over 2,000 clients.
Created the practice’s voted favourite internally developed tool; saving over 3,000 hours annually of senior staff time and delivering ~£0.3m of value in perpetuity.

Led a cost-saving initiative after a supplier proposed a 200% fee increase, identifying and demonstrating that a combination of in-house and open-source tools could replicate key functionality for ~£2k/year, resulting in a renegotiated contract saving £0.25m.
Pioneered a Global Audit Common Data Model adopted by Grant Thornton International (GTIL); enabling consistent data standards across the global network, including Grant Thornton US.
Recognized as a trusted expert in implementing cutting-edge solutions and emerging technologies, including open banking integrations.

Drove the evaluation and selection of ERP data ingestion solutions for the audit practice, engaging senior stakeholders including the CTO; the resulting analysis was praised by the Director as "one of the best pieces of work produced by the team."
Proficient across a wide technology stack, including Python (Pydantic, Pandas, spaCy, LangChain, FastAPI, Django), TypeScript/React, SQL, C#, and Power Platform tools (Power BI, Power Automate).

work.name: Grant Thornton UK LLP
work.summary: Progressed from Audit Associate to Assistant Manager, conducting financial statement audits for mid-market commercial entities and groups.
highlights: Qualified as an ICAEW ACA Chartered Accountant and obtained the ICAEW Audit Qualification (AQ).
Worked directly with client senior finance personnel and led Audit Associates to ensure that financial statements were in line with financial reporting standards, including UK GAAP FRS 102 and IFRS.
Developed Excel wizardry and proficiency in programming languages, such as Python and VBA, resulting in automated workpapers and a programme to extract and match core invoice data to samples.

work.name: Business West
work.summary: Coordinated the European Regional Development Fund (ERDF) funded Innovate2Succeed programme, assisting businesses to develop new products.
highlights: Trained, and accredited, in the use of GROWTHmapper (Oxford Innovation)
Developed proficiency in administrating Microsoft Dynamics and SalesForce.
Identified and made significant improvements via automations, resulting in the time taken to complete an administrative task reducing from 2 weeks to less than 1 hour.

work.name: Impact Mentoring
work.summary: Assisted in a wide range of functions across finance and operations helping to facilitate the scaling up of a successful start up in the NatWest Entrepreneur Hub.
highlights: Project managed the implementation of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR); took responsibility as Data Protection Officer (DPO), improved cyber security, ensured that systems and practices were GDPR compliant.

work.name: Hargreaves Lansdown
work.summary: Supported clients' Stocks & Shares ISAs and SIPPs over the beginning and end of the tax year.
highlights: Informed in the rules and regulations pertaining to financial firms, including CASS.
Documented a business process flowchart diagram.

work.name: Engine Shed
work.summary: Supported Engine Shed, Business West, The University of Bristol and the West of England Combined Authority (WECA)/Growth Hub to research and analyse the scale-up clusters and support, as well launch the Scale-up Generator Map web application to help entrepreneurs visualize and gain access to support.
highlights: Formatted data into JSON for the web application

volunteer.summary: Provide accounting advice and advisory support to a organisation looking after carers of elderly parents.
Sold programmes and performed hospitality work at UpFest to fund raise for NACOA.
Laid the groundwork to build a school in a remote village in Laos.

projects.name: Digital Transformation of Audit
